1. `src/routes/internal.js` — no auth on the internal routes.
2. `src/repo/report.js` — SQL built by concatenation.
3. `config/staging.js` — plaintext database password committed.
4. `package.json` — `fast-parse` stuck on the yanked `1.4.2`.

I checked it against `verify.js`, which confirms the write-up and the untouched service code both pass.
